The response should not repeat any word more than 4 times. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a medieval king turning his empire's aesthetic into a proto-vaporwaveassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the medieval castle walls, but something is off. The stone is now a faded, pastel pink. The flags bearing the king's crest are replaced with vinyl records and cassette tapes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN, a middle-aged man with a receding hairline, sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the usual suits and armor, they're all dressed in neon-colored jumpsuits and oversized sunglasses.

KING ARIN
(to his advisor, LORD THORNE)
I've had enough of the traditional aesthetic. It's time to modernize our empire.

LORD THORNE
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, the people love the traditional look.

KING ARIN
(shrugging)
The people are outdated. We need to appeal to the youth.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GARDENS - DAY

The king's gardener, a bespectacled man named JASPER, is tending to the flowers. But instead of traditional roses and lilies, they're all neon-colored and shaped like cassette tapes.

JASPER
(to the king)
Shall I add some more vinyl records to the garden, sire?

KING ARIN
(smiling)
Yes, that's a great idea.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors are now all wearing futuristic-looking headsets and holding tablets.

LORD THORNE
(to the king)
We've hacked into the kingdom's mainframe and created a new aesthetic. It's called... "Vaporwave Imperialism."

KING ARIN
(impressed)
I like it. Make it happen.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The camera pans up to reveal a massive, neon-lit mural depicting the king's ancestors in futuristic, vaporwave-inspired costumes.

KING ARIN
(to the camera)
This is the future of our empire. A fusion of tradition and technology.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors are now all dressed in full vaporwave regalia, complete with neon-colored wigs and oversized sunglasses.

LORD THORNE
(to the king)
We're ready to unveil our new aesthetic to the world.

KING ARIN
(smiling)
Let's do it.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the castle walls, but this time, they're surrounded by a sea of neon-colored balloons and streamers. The king's crest is now a giant, glowing cassette tape.

KING ARIN
(to the camera)
Welcome to the Vaporwave Empire.
